description:
VPN client for privacy and a secure connection, with the Meduza and ULTRA protocols.

MeduzaVPN is a VPN client that protects your privacy and keeps your connection secure on public and home networks.
It supports our own protocols, Meduza and ULTRA, alongside WireGuard, OpenVPN and VLESS.
Features include a choice of VPN locations, IPv6 leak protection and one account across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.
A MeduzaVPN account is required; a subscription can be purchased on the website.
